payload.message: In one or two sentences, what should a reviewer check first in a PR that adds a new API endpoint? Please keep your answer to one or two sentences.

payload.reply: A reviewer should first verify the endpoint's input validation and error handling — confirming all request inputs are validated and that error responses are well-structured. They should also confirm authentication and authorization checks are applied to the new route before reviewing business logic.
